## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION; style mixed / no clear leadership. NVDA ABOVE TREND, XOM ABOVE TREND and JPM ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence among large caps (AAPL, META, TSLA) and mixed sentiment that could produce short-term trend breaks — watch for confirmation.
